Synthetic test files for founder_requests tests, written by the builder on 2026-10-23. Not real data.

- `synthetic_brasswick_hiring_plan.csv`: a made-up Brasswick hiring plan in the columns the repo's synthetic rooms use (`headcount_after_hire` last), so every scan can read it.
- `synthetic_brasswick_hiring_plan_own_columns.csv`: the same plan in a founder's own columns, without `headcount_after_hire`. An add must still finish and say what happened when a scan cannot read it.
